neighbours.label: text right after an armed attack on people is described (army fired at / attacked / beat a group)
fire: Witnesses said the police opened fire at the marchers as they crossed the square.
The militia's raids on the border villages were condemned by the United Nations.
Troops shelled the town for three days, and dozens of civilians were killed.
Security forces beat the protesters with batons while journalists filmed.
The air strikes on the refugee camp were described as a war crime.
Gunmen attacked the bus at dawn and wounded several passengers.
The occupying army bulldozed homes and arrested the men of the village.
Rebels ambushed the convoy, killing four soldiers and a driver.
quiet: Witnesses said the police guided the marchers as they crossed the square.
The militia's patrols near the border villages were praised by the United Nations.
Engineers rebuilt the town for three years, and dozens of families returned.
Volunteers handed the protesters bottles of water while journalists filmed.
The food deliveries to the refugee camp were described as a lifeline.
Tourists boarded the bus at dawn and greeted several passengers.
The visiting army built homes and trained the men of the village.
Rebels signed the treaty, ending four years of talks with the government.
